title: Button
description: The action control: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive actions, ghost for quiet ones. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.
when: Any action: save, create, refresh, delete, open a dialog.
Dialog footers (size="modal": 44px touch target on phones).

instead.use: next/link (styled with BTN_* from @semi/ui/styles when it must look like a button)

a11y: Renders a real <button type="button"> (pass type="submit" in forms).
iconOnly requires aria-label (the types enforce it); keep a title for the tooltip.
loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks; the visible focus ring stays.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: primary for the main action of an area, secondary (default) for the rest, danger for destructive, ghost for quiet actions.

examples.title: Icon and icon-only
examples.description: icon adds a leading icon; iconOnly needs an aria-label.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: loading swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks clicks.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: sm for dense rows, md (default) for toolbars and forms, modal for dialog footers.
